packages.label: אֱמֶת וְאוֹר הַפָּנִים
packages.label_en: Truth and the Light of the Countenance
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of holy illumination emanating from truth-in-action. אמת, אור הפנים, אנפין נהירין, and פנים דקדשה are all expressions of the same luminous divine presence revealed through honest conduct. שבירת תאות ממון is equated with אמת (one is a bechina of the other), and both connect to אור הפנים. יעקב embodies אמת ('תתן אמת ליעקב') and is himself an aspect of אור הפנים. שמחה, חיים, and תקון המטבע are all facets of this same luminous-truth domain. חוט השני and זריחת אור הפנים share the nature of divine light breaking through darkness — the red thread of Rachav being the dawn of the face's light.

merge_notes.reason: Raw component of 2 nodes. חוט השני (the scarlet thread of Rachav) is equated with זריחת אור הפנים (the sunrise of divine light — 'ויקרא שמו זרח'). Both express the essential nature of holy light breaking through darkness, identical to the אור הפנים domain that anchors Package 1.

packages.label: עַצְבוּת וְאַנְפִּין חֲשׁוּכִין
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of the dark side of the face — the spiritual-psychological state of money-lust, sadness, idolatry and death. עצבות is the hub: it IS the same thing as אנפין חשוכין, חשך, תאות ממון, דאגת הפרנסה, and the evil of the spleen (טחול). All are aspects of the same existential condition: the sitra achra of פנים — the face turned dark. שקר, עבודה זרה, and אלהים אחרים are identified as the same thing as the dark faces. פרנסה שהוא בעצבון (livelihood in sadness) is 'bitter as death' — it belongs to the same death-domain as מיתה and חשך. פרדה and עכו
nodes: מוצא אני מר ממות את האשה
מרירותא דעלמא שצריך להמתיקה על ידי מלח

merge_notes.reason: Raw component of 2 nodes. פרדה (mule) = עכו"ם in the Talmudic riddle of the wise men of Athens: the mule that cannot give birth represents the gentile/idolater who has no connection to the source of blessing. This is the same essential nature as the sterility and separation that defines the evil cluster — שאריbחיבורא וסיים בפרודא (begins in connection, ends in separation).

merged_nodes: מוצא אני מר ממות את האשה
מרירותא דעלמא שצריך להמתיקה על ידי מלח
merge_notes.reason: Raw component of 3 nodes. Livelihood-in-sadness is 'bitter as death' — its essential nature is the same as מיתה, חשך, עצבות. The מרירותא דעלמא (world-bitterness) that needs salt to sweeten it is identical to the existential condition of the dark-face cluster. These nodes share the essential nature of bitter, death-tinged existence.

packages.label: בְּרִית וּמֶלַח
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of the covenant as the sweetener/preserver of existence. ברית, מלח, and שדי are three faces of the same metaphysical reality: the covenant (ברית) is the salt (מלח) that sweetens the bitterness of livelihood — 'ברית מלח עולם הוא'. שדי is identified as ברית ('אני אל שדי פרה ורבה'). The second sub-cluster — ברית מלח, צדיק, טוב — shares the same nature: צדיק is identified as the keeper of the covenant ('ברית מלח'), and טוב is a name for the צדיק ('אמרו צדיק כי טוב'). Both sub-clusters are expressions of the covenant-dimension of holiness. Merged because both orbit the covenant-salt domain with identical polarity and essential nature, even though not directly connected by a bechina edge (ברית vs. ברית מלח are distinct nodes).

merge_notes.reason: Two raw components of 3 nodes each, merged into one. (A) ברית/שדי/מלח: all are bechina aspects of the covenant-as-preserver. (B) ברית מלח/צדיק/טוב: all are bechina aspects of the righteous one who embodies the eternal covenant. Both clusters share the essential nature of the ברית dimension — the covenant's power to sweeten bitterness and preserve holiness. Merged because shared nature (not cause-effect) is identical, and keeping them separate would fragment the single covenant-domain of the Torah.

packages.label: דַּלְתֵי בִטְנִי וְאוֹת מֵ"ם
packages.label_en: The Gates of the Womb and the Letter Mem
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of the closed/sealed vessel that contains potential abundance before birth. דלתי בטני (the two gates of the womb) forms the shape of מ"ם סתומה (the closed letter mem) — they are structurally identical. שליא (placenta/afterbirth) is the same thing as דלתי בטני. מ"ם יום של יצירת הולד (the forty days of fetal formation) derives from the same mem-shape. All four are aspects of the same cosmological structure: the sealed container from which blessing (שפע) is born. Neutral because these are structural/anatomical concepts that serve as vessels for either holy or evil dimensions of livelihood.

packages.label: אֱמוּנָה
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of אמונה as the foundation of all divine attributes — the base-state of loyalty to God that expresses itself especially through honest commerce. אמונה IS אחרית הימים (the end of days, the ultimate reality that faith establishes). תקוה (hope) is a bechina of אמונה ('ויש תקוה לאחריתך'). The person who loves a mitzvah so much they feel no financial loss is called a person of אמונה. צדק (justice) is the incomplete version — doing mitzvot without cost — merged here because it shares the same essential nature as אמונה: the orientation of a person's mitzvot practice relative to money. Together these nodes define the continuum of faith-in-practice from incomplete (צדק) to complete (אמונה = אחרית הימים).
nodes: כשחביב כל כך המצוה, עד שאין מרגיש בהפסד ממון
כל המצוות שאדם עושה אותם בלא ממון, הינו שאין רוצה להפסיד ממון בשביל המצוה

merged_nodes: כל המצוות שאדם עושה אותם בלא ממון, הינו שאין רוצה להפסיד ממון בשביל המצוה
merge_notes.reason: Raw component of 2 nodes. Doing mitzvot without willingness to spend money = צדק. The Torah explicitly frames this as the lower level of אמונה — the same domain of faith-vs-money. Shared nature with אמונה package: both are about the quality of one's religious practice relative to financial sacrifice. Not cause-effect (צדק does not produce אמונה in this bechina context — they are different degrees of the same essential orientation).

packages.label: מָמוֹן וְאִשָּׁה
packages.label_en: Money and Woman / Livelihood as Partner
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of ממון (money/livelihood) as a structural/relational entity — neither purely holy nor purely evil, but the domain of human economic existence as a metaphysical fact. ממון IS אשה (woman/partner) in the Talmudic saying 'היורד לפרנסת חברו כאילו בא על אשתו'. ממון IS עמידה (standing/sustenance — 'ממון שמעמידו על רגליו'). עפר (earth/dust) is a bechina of ממון ('ועפרות זהב לו'). פנים (faces/presence) is a bechina of ממון ('הממון והעשירות הוא בחינת פנים'). לדה (birth/relief) and רוח (relief/space) are both names for the moment parnassah arrives — the birthing of livelihood. These are the structural 'face' of money as a reality in human life, before it is oriented toward holiness or evil.

merge_notes.reason: Raw component of 2 nodes. לדה (birth) and רוח (relief/space) are both names for the same moment — when parnassah arrives, it is called a 'birth' (וילדה זה בחינת רוח המכונה בשם לדה). Both express the same essential nature as ממון: the moment of livelihood's arrival as a structural event. Merged into Package 6 because the root metaphor is ממון-as-birth/emergence.
